pkgmetadata.longdescription: Brave is a privacy-focused web browser based on Chromium, with a built-in ad and tracker blocker (Shields). This package builds it from source (brave-core plus Chromium) and lets each of Brave's optional features be left out at build time.

use.flag: Build Brave Ads (privacy-preserving ads that pay Basic Attention Tokens)
Build Leo, Brave's AI assistant
Build and install chromedriver (as brave-chromedriver) for WebDriver automation

Build with the user's CFLAGS/LDFLAGS (e.g. -O3 -march=native) through the unbundle toolchain instead of upstream's tuned ones. Code built for a specific CPU level and selected at runtime keeps its own -march; Rust code is not affected. Unsupported
Build the onboarding/education pages that introduce Brave's features
Build with GTK4 headers (GTK4 file dialogs and theming)
Enable support for Google Hangouts features such as screen sharing
Build Brave News, the news feed on the New Tab Page
Official build: ThinLTO, CFI and upstream's release optimisations. Slower to build and needs more memory
Brave Origin branding: a stripped-down Brave without the Web3, rewards, ads, news, AI and Tor features
Build PageGraph, Brave's research instrumentation of page loads
Build Playlist, to save audio/video for later or offline playback
Enable proprietary codecs like H.264, H.265 (HEVC) and AAC
Build PSST (Privacy Settings Selection Tool), which helps tighten privacy settings on websites
Add Qt6 support (shim library loaded at runtime) for native Qt look and file dialogs
Inspect RAR downloads with Safe Browsing using the non-free unRAR code
Build Brave Rewards (Basic Attention Token wallet for creators); needs ads
Enable support for remote desktop and screen cast using media-video/pipewire
Build Speedreader, a reader mode that strips pages down to their text
Use the system media-libs/harfbuzz instead of the bundled one
Use the system app-arch/zstd instead of the bundled one
Build Brave Talk integration (private video calls)
Build private windows with Tor
Build per-container traffic control
Enable hardware-accelerated video decoding and encoding with media-libs/libva
Build Brave Wallet (crypto wallet, Web3 and Snaps support)
Offer the Wayback Machine (Internet Archive) on "page not found" errors
Build the Web Discovery Project, opt-in contribution of anonymous search data to Brave Search
